name: 案件名付きの日程バー
prompt:
Use case: text-localization / ui-mockup. LH09-0053 timeline project-name and scheduled bar.
Use ORIGINAL image2 crop as edit base; image1 full context. Originals PRIMARY for bar geometry/proportions, fine strokes, vertical gridlines, exact dependency curve/dot positions and visible clipping. Image3 mock SECONDARY Japanese wording only; its mint rectangle below the bar is invented, omit it.
Exact label「利用者体験の調査支援」at original top-left, Meiryo Regular14/24 tracking0, not bold. Below label keep original SHORT EMPTY horizontal rounded-rectangle schedule bar: pure white interior, thin forest-green #1F6444 outline replacing original purple, original small width/height/corners. Preserve original visible RED DOTTED dependency connector curving from right edge of this bar, looping right then down-left to the partially clipped red circular endpoint at bottom-left of original component crop. Same path and clipping as original; do not fabricate an unseen continuation or remove dependency. Keep faint neutral vertical timeline gridlines exactly as source.
Pure-white canvas/background, no extra container, green fill, mint blocks, second bar, extra text or date controls. Compact faithful export, original visible state and information, slate/neutral supporting detail. Original fine geometry over mock approximations.
reviewNotes: Source empty bar and red dependency/clipped minus endpoint restored; Japanese title checked, invented mint block omitted. Connector dashes/strokes too heavy relative to original; targeted optical correction needed.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
